package.name: amr_dispatcher_proto_cli
package.description:
ros2 CLI extension for inspecting protobuf-encoded ROS topics.
Provides `ros2 amr echo`, which parses topics published by amr_dispatcher_proto. This exists because `ros2 topic echo` cannot parse protobuf topics: it resolves message types by importing a Python module whose class exposes SLOT_TYPES (a rosidl generator artifact), which protobuf types do not have. That limitation is architectural, not a configuration issue.
This command instead uses rclpy's raw subscription mode to receive the DDS payload as bytes, then parses it with a dynamically constructed protobuf descriptor pool.
